snippet.title: Save the World - Now Free-to-Play!
snippet.description:
The day has come! Fortnite Save the World is officially free-to-play, welcoming more players into the fight - including on Nintendo Switch 2. Everyone who pre-registered before April 16 will receive all unlocked community rewards, while existing owners will also receive Superchargers, Vouchers and Gold for keeping the fight going. 

Homebase is waiting!  Get caught up on all of the updates to Save the World to jump in ready to play: https://fn.gg/stw-update-notes and download here: https://fn.gg/savetheworldftp 

Follow us on social:
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/fortnite/​
Twitter: https://x.com/Fortnite
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/FortniteGame/​
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@Fortnite

Learn More: https://www.epicgames.com/fortnite/en-US/home
